title: Master status names the longest coordination-lock hold, and per-item and connect writes never wait on it
description: On a running test install, a transaction holding the coordination lock 3 s is named with its duration as the longest hold of the last 10 minutes, and a preview record, an agent connect and a host key answer in under 1 s while another transaction holds the lock.

steps.name: names the longest coordination-lock hold and answers lock-free writes in under 1 s
